name: Kolaghan
description: Kolaghan is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a feral lightning-breathing dragonlord who leads clan Kolaghan, the dragon revered by the Mardu.

description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

summary.text: Kolaghan is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a feral lightning-breathing dragonlord who leads clan Kolaghan, the dragon revered by the Mardu.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

bio.text: Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon, and Kolaghan's brood strafed with lightning.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

bio.text: In the original timeline the brood lost to the clans after Ugin's death, and Kolaghan was smashed against the cliff at Wingthrone, her skull becoming the Mardu khan's throne.

citations.text: "Kolaghan", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sandsteppe", section "Historical". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the current timeline she met Alesha and let her pass without attacking, and Alesha threw down the khan's banner and chose to follow her.

citations.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.
"Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.
"Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Her reign ended the Mardu name and the use of the word khan, and her brood raided other clans such as the Dromoka.

citations.text: "Kolaghan", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kolaghan", section "Clan Kolaghan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

bio.text: Her brood fought on the front line in the New Phyrexian Invasion and suffered heavy losses, and the weakened dragonlords then faced growing humanoid rebellions.

citations.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kolaghan", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: A rebellion defeated her alongside the other dragonlords, and the dragonlords were also swallowed by the storm when Narset's ritual summoned the spirit dragons.

citations.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kolaghan", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kolaghan", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: She is defeated and fallen, and after her fall Zurgo leads the Mardu as khan.

citations.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kolaghan approaches Alesha and Jagun on the steppe, then lets them pass without attacking.
timeline.quote: Then the dragon's mouth closed.

citation.text: "Jagun Wingmate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alesha discards the Mardu banner, declares that Kolaghan does not want to lead, and rides after the dragon with both bodyguards.
timeline.quote: She told her two bodyguards that Kolaghan did not want to lead and that her people did not have to kneel.

citation.text: "Jagun Wingmate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Kolaghan's brood lost to the clans after Ugin's death; Kolaghan smashed into the cliff at Wingthrone and her skull became the Mardu khan's throne.
timeline.quote: her skull was used as the throne of the Mardu khan

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alesha learns Kolaghan does not want to lead or enslave the Mardu, and she and her warriors follow the dragon as equals.
timeline.quote: was not interested in leading or enslaving the Mardu

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kolaghan and her brood claim leadership over the Mardu by force, creating a new clan.
timeline.quote: She and her brood claimed leadership over the Mardu by force

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under the dragons' leadership the Mardu become increasingly barbaric.
timeline.quote: Under the leadership of the dragons, the Mardu became increasingly barbaric, forsaking what honor they had possessed before.

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zurgo leads the rebellion against Kolaghan and becomes Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual.
timeline.quote: In the current timeline, he led the Mardu rebellion against Kolaghan and became Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual .

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alesha and the Mardu follow the dragonlord Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: Alesha and the Mardu decide to forsake their previous clan and follow dragonlord Kolaghan .

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khanfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: A dragon's lightning breath terrifies Alesha, recalling the scars on her back from an earlier dragon, and she leaps from her horse.
timeline.quote: a memory of past terror, when another spawn of Kolaghan's brood had given her the scars she wore on her back.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Jagun, and Doshiyn encounter Kolaghan, who lets them pass without attack.
timeline.quote: The dragon's mouth closed. Alesha lowered her bow.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha throws down the Mardu khan's banner and decides that she and the Mardu will follow Kolaghan rather than kneel.
timeline.quote: We don't have to kneel," said Alesha, grinning. "Just try to keep up."

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Zurgo, now the bell-striker, who does not know Sarkhan and says no one says the word khan under Kolaghan Dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan Dragonlord kill khan-sayers.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A Kolaghan raiding party disguised as merchants catches Dirgur's garrison off guard; Zhiada kills its orc leader.
timeline.quote: She personally killed the raiding party's leader, a huge orc, although the survivors fled with clan treasures.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, once the Mardu khan of another timeline, serves as Kolaghan's bell-striker, rousing warriors with his greatsword when she stirs to battle.
timeline.quote: Zurgo has been reduced to serving as an attendant to the dragonlord Kolaghan.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Kolaghan joins the ban on the word khan and the old clan names.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan participated in the ban on the words "khan" and the names of the old clans

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under Kolaghan's reign the Mardu name is forgotten and the group becomes clan Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: the group became known as clan Kolaghan

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Clan Kolaghan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kolaghan's brood fights on the frontline in the New Phyrexian Invasion and suffers heavy losses, driving out the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Though they ultimately drove the Phyrexian invaders out

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebel leaders raise the Mardu banner and begin open war against Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: Several rebel leaders raised the Mardu banner and started the open war against Kolaghan

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rebellion grows into a formidable army and defeats Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: ultimately allowing the Mardu to defeat Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Oret and Captain Anafenza flee a Kolaghan horde through a canyon after their fortress falls and their lines break.
timeline.quote: But here they were, their fortress lost and their lines broken, fleeing for their lives before the bulk of a Kolaghan horde.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: A Kolaghan orc kills Oret's ibex with a lightning spear and attacks him; Anafenza kills the orc by drawing out his life with golden-white light.
timeline.quote: It passed through him, pulling something unseen but vital from him as it passed, leaving him lifeless in the dust.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Gvar Barzeel and dozens of Kolaghan warriors enter the chamber, and Anafenza calls on the tree's ancestors.
timeline.quote: Spirits of this tree, ancestors of my people, your descendants need you.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza merges with the ancestor spirits and kills Gvar and his entire warband.
timeline.quote: Gvar, the shamans, all of the Kolaghan raiders—they didn't stand a chance.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: A dragon of Kolaghan's brood dives at Anafenza and is torn apart by a bolt of golden light made of spirits, while the rest flee.
timeline.quote: They moved as a massive bolt of golden light, and at its advance the dragon tried to reverse course.

citation.text: "The Guardian" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
timeline.quote: He encounters the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Vial Smasher spends a lifetime handling and smashing vials of dragonfire in the Kolaghan clan.
timeline.quote: she has spent a lifetime handling—and smashing—vials of this dangerous substance

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion and reduced dragonstorms weaken the dragonlords, letting humanoid rebellions grow.
timeline.quote: The humanoid rebellions were able to gain traction

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ritual summons five spirit dragons; the dragonlords fight them and are defeated, swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: In the end, the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
timeline.quote: snake-headed Silumgar, Atarka with her crown of antlers, spined Kolaghan, Dromoka shining like the sun, and of course, feathered Ojutai

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sultai noble tells the Mardu engineer how a hungry Mardu boy killed her for two days of rice.
timeline.quote: He killed me for two days' worth of rice.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alesha and her clan rode in the trail of Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: they rode out across the plains in the trail of Kolaghan

citation.text: "Khanfall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In ancient times Kolaghan dies at the Wingthrone, smashed against a cliffside.
timeline.quote: the Mardu fortress where Kolaghan died in ancient times, smashed against a cliffside

citation.text: "Sandsteppe", section "Historical". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Zurgo Bellstriker serves Kolaghan's brood, harassed by dragons.
timeline.quote: a subject to the brood of the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zurgo unifies Kolaghan's warriors into an army that survives the attack.
timeline.quote: directed the disconnected Kolaghan warriors into a unified army

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the fall of Kolaghan, Zurgo Stormrender leads the Mardu as khan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo Stormrender now leads the Mardu as khan

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
